Regulatory minimum capital adequacy ratio of 13.0 percent, quoted in the BoG Monetary Policy Report September 2026 (solvency section): industry CAR 19.1 percent in Aug 2026 'well above the regulatory minimum requirement of 13.0 percent' (S-BOG-MPR-SEP26, read by claude). Earlier history: a temporary lower 10 percent threshold under DDEP forbearance applied in 2024 and expired by Dec 2025 (per gemini's review citing CalBank AR 2024 p.120 and codex's reading of GCB FY2025; not verified by claude).

Minimum paid-up capital of GHS 400 million required by 31 Dec 2018 (BoG Notice BG/GOV/SEC/2017/19, S-BOG-CAP17). A search on 2026-11-25 found NO newer minimum for universal banks (2026 capital reforms found apply to microfinance and community banks only), but this is not proof. Treat as an unconfirmed carry-forward until a reviewer confirms with the BoG.
